extracted.intended_audience: researchers seeking pancreatic cancer research funding from the Lustgarten Foundation; general public interested in the Foundation's research priorities
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of the Lustgarten Foundation's research priorities and expectations for work they fund, aimed at researchers and stakeholders in pancreatic cancer research. Describes target research areas, desired investigator qualities, and translational goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Our comprehensive research program focuses on early detection and interception, therapeutic development, and personalized medicine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds should align with one or more of these priority areas to advance the most cutting-edge research toward clinical impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translational impact / bench-to-clinic
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring the most cutting-edge research from the lab bench to the clinic, where it can be tested on patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that enable testing in patients and have clear paths to clinical application — with the goal of improving quality of life and moving toward a cure — are prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance understanding of disease initiation and progression
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim to advance breakthroughs in the understanding of the initiation and progression of pancreatic cancer to improve diagnosis and treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should produce insights that meaningfully improve diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator excellence / preeminence
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is committed to the world's preeminent pancreatic cancer researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to demonstrate high-level expertise, track record, or leadership in pancreatic cancer research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovative approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Lustgarten-funded researchers take an innovative approach to solving the complexities of pancreatic cancer leading to lifesaving breakthroughs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should emphasize novel concepts, methods, or strategies that address unmet needs in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity of research teams
rubrics_metrics.description: Solving the complexities of pancreatic cancer requires diversity of thought, education, training, background, and experience of the scientists investigating the disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams that bring diverse perspectives and complementary expertise are encouraged and viewed as important to achieving breakthroughs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-centered mission alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation is committed to transforming pancreatic cancer into a curable disease and improving patient outcomes and long-term survival.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded work should align with the Foundation's mission to improve patient prognosis and provide hope for a cure; emphasis on meaningful patient benefit is expected.
